title: Solar energy: share of stories, all-time base
author: film-cards
hypothesis: Titles about solar energy take at least as large a share of HN stories in the latest 12 months as they did across all earlier years.
expect: Share of stories in the latest 12 months divided by the pooled share of all earlier stories since 2006: at least 1.5x strongly supports growth, at least 0.8x weakly supports persistence; at or below 0.5x refutes. Between is inconclusive. Title matches only, the dictionary is in scripts/film.py.
thresholds_note: Exploratory. Thresholds copied from the card this one replaces.
caveats: HN attention is not technical validation, adoption, revenue or investment return.
Title matching only; some titles about the theme will be missed and some matches will be false. Archive scores for 2025-26 stories are low for all stories, so the points cards use ratios.
Solar matches panels, power, energy, cells and photovoltaics, not eclipses or the solar system.
